lines.text: Most of Amazon's profit doesn't come from your packages.
lines.say: Most of Amazon's profit doesn't come from your packages.

lines.text: Amazon made $28.1 billion in operating profit from July through September.
lines.say: Amazon made twenty-eight point one billion dollars in operating profit from July through September.

lines.text: Its cloud arm, AWS, made $17.8 billion of that. Everything else, mostly its stores, made $10.3 billion.
lines.say: Its cloud arm, A W S, made seventeen point eight billion dollars of that. Everything else, mostly its stores, made ten point three billion.

lines.text: By our math, that's about 63% of the profit from about 23% of the sales.
lines.say: By our math, that's about sixty-three percent of the profit from about twenty-three percent of the sales.

lines.text: AWS rents out computer power for other companies' apps and AI.
lines.say: A W S rents out computer power for other companies' apps and AI.

lines.text: AWS sales hit $46.0 billion, up 39% in a year, its fastest growth in nearly five years.
lines.say: A W S sales hit forty-six billion dollars, up thirty-nine percent in a year, its fastest growth in nearly five years.

lines.text: The rest of Amazon, mostly stores, sells far more, about $156 billion, but keeps thin slices.
lines.say: The rest of Amazon, mostly stores, sells far more, about a hundred fifty-six billion dollars, but keeps thin slices.

lines.text: So the box on your porch is the famous part. Renting computers is the money part.
lines.say: So the box on your porch is the famous part. Renting computers is the money part.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Most of Amazon's profit doesn't come from your packages
post.ig:
Most of Amazon's profit doesn't come from your packages.
Amazon made $28.1B in operating profit in Jul-Sep 2026.
Its AWS cloud unit made $17.8B of it; its North America and International segments (stores, ads, subscriptions) made $10.3B combined.
By our math, AWS earned about 63% of the profit on about 23% of sales. AWS sales rose 39% to $46.0B.
Sources: Amazon Q3 2026 earnings release (Oct 29, 2026), SEC 8-K.
News and education, not financial advice.
